meta.description: Unlike NRL/NFL/Super Rugby/EPL, there is no manually-curated historical spreadsheet behind this file - it started empty and is built entirely from TheSportsDB going forward, backfilled a few seasons on its first run. Covers all of the National Provincial Championship's sponsorship-name eras (ITM Cup, Mitre 10 Cup, Bunnings NPC) as one continuous competition, matching how Super Rugby's file already treats its own era/branding variants.
